messages:
mikhail: Planning a careful catalog enable for atlas-65b-v1 tonight in the 02:00-03:30 PT change window. Proposed plan: 0.25% -> 2% -> 10% -> 40% with 15m observation windows. Posting fallback ladder and quick rollback thresholds.

zoe: Ack schedule. What's fallback ordering for memory-constrained regions?

mikhail: Fallback ladder: 1) atlas-65b-v1-quant (primary) 2) atlas-65b-v1-fp16 3) atlas-legacy-65b. For memory constrained regions we prefer fp16 earlier to avoid OOMs.

tasha: Propose rollback triggers: p95 +200ms sustained 10m; error rate >0.6% for 5m; quality delta (seedset) >3% BLEU drop -> pause. Also token-cost +35% => pause.

mikhail: Added. Also adding autoscaler rule: if queue growth >30% for 2 samples (5m) and new nodes not provisioned in 6m => rollback.

deploybot: deploybot: preflight passed (checksum, quotas, telemetry). Scheduling enable at 2024-09-02T02:00:00-07:00. Stages queued. Use `deploybot watch 1769999999`.

eng-oncall: I'll be oncall and will run the emergency unpin if needed. Please paste exact commands in runbook.

mikhail: Runbook snippet added: curl -X POST "https://catalog.redwood.internal/pin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"atlas-65b-v1","percent":2,"reason":"staged-1769999999"}' and unpin curl -X POST "https://catalog.redwood.internal/unpin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"atlas-65b-v1","reason":"rollback-1769999999"}'.

zoe: Will warm KV cache between 10%->40% for 8m using `tools/kv_warm --model atlas-65b-v1 --duration 8m`. Also enabling sample-based quality gate from /evals/atlas/seedset-v1.

tasha: I'll watch cost dashboards; if token-cost delta hits 35% I'll pause and post snapshot.

mikhail: Final: proceed with staged enable. eng-oncall executes rollback. Notifying product and support. I'll post a short release note after 2% goes live.

zoe: :thumbsup: good luck everyone.
